Design System

Flexfetch token layer

Every token declared in DESIGN.md, rendered live from theme.css. Values come from CSS variables, so this page auto-updates when the theme is regenerated. Resize the window — the viewport indicator in the bottom-right tracks breakpoints in real time.

Motion

Transform + opacity only, guarded by prefers-reduced-motion. Hover to feel each duration.
